title: bank_transfer
summary: Concurrent bidirectional bank account transfers with atomicity, consistent balances, per-transaction receipt numbers, and deadlock freedom.

domain_types.name: Receipt
domain_types.description: Pure receipt number and transfer amount fields without synchronization or strings

resource_specs.name: total_balance
resource_specs.description: Modeled invariant sum of both account balances

resource_specs.name: receipt_counter
resource_specs.description: Modeled count of generated transaction receipts

clauses.text: The system must never deadlock under concurrent transfer_ab and transfer_ba execution.
At all reachable states, total_balance remains equal to 200 (total_balance == 200).
At all reachable states, receipt_counter stays within 0..=2 (receipt_counter <= 2).
Whenever a transfer is initiated, on all execution paths receipt_counter eventually increases by one.
Both transfer_ab and transfer_ba workers must be able to complete execution.
Construct, inspect, and update Receipt entries and pure integer receipt numbers inside sequential/type holes without synchronization, loops, unsafe, or String formatting.

source_nl: 实现一个简单的银行账户转账功能：支持在两个账户之间并发发起双向转账并为每笔交易生成回执编号，保证转账原子性、账目一致且绝不死锁。
